{{Quote|The Gordian Reach...? I-isn't that where the Yavin system lies...?!"''<br>''"Yavin. Krylon. Torque. A jillion more.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Jorman Thoad]]|<ref name="SW1977 25">[[Star Wars (1977) 25|''Star Wars'' (1977) 25]]</ref>}}
The '''Gordian Reach''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], named for the [[Gordian Reach (hyperspace route)|Gordian Reach]], an old [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that had run through the region.

==Astrography==
[[File:Gordian_Reach.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Gordian Reach and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Gordian Reach<ref name="SW1977 25" /> was bounded to Rimward by the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]], and was broadly divided into two regions, the [[Loop Worlds]] along the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] near the [[Hydian Way]], and the [[Back Reach]] to the galactic east, beyond [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Gordian Reach's most important worlds were located along the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] just off the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], including [[Pinoora]], [[Jovan III]], [[Presbalin]], and the sector capital of [[Torque]]. Rimward of the [[Loop Worlds]] were the rarely-traversed [[Wetyin's Way]] and the [[Pinooran Spur/Legends|Pinooran Spur]], which included the planets [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], [[Glade]] and [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]], and [[Krylon]], [[Betshish]], [[Marrovia]] and [[Kushibah]]. The two hyperroutes were linked by the [[Yavin Bypass/Legends|Yavin Bypass]], passing by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Korphir Trace]] crossed a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]] to link the [[Back Reach]] and the worlds of [[Arda II]] and [[Feena]]. The Back Reach had little historical connection to the Loop Worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

The Reach also included the territory of [[400100500260026]] and the [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The worlds of the [[Back Reach]] as far as [[Troos]] were part of [[Xim's empire]] from [[25,116 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] escaped from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces towards the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], he hid in what became known as the Gordian Reach, on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="TFotSE">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]''</ref>

A millennium later, the Sith Lord [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] used the temples Sadow built as his personal base during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="DLotS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> In [[3955 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tol Cressa]] assigned a [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system]] to restore the area to its former glory. However the droids began a bloody coup, setting themselves up as dictators and seizing all 16 habitable worlds. After millions were slaughtered, Cressa sent a military task force to deal with the rogue droids.<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> In the aftermath of the [[Old Sith Wars]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] expunged all records of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was charted by [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] in [[3693 BBY]], scouts and settlers moving north up the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] and the [[praedium]]s branching off it rediscovered the region. One such hyperlane, the [[Gordian Reach (hyperspace route)|Gordian Reach]], stretched from the [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] on the Hydian Way to [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] beyond the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] Rimward of the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. Briefly a significant hyperroute in the Outer Rim, shifting stars eventually erased the route, though the arc of thousands of star systems along the old route was still sometimes called that by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] by the the [[Rise of the Empire era]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Gordian Reach had been reduced to a minor route that gave its name to an unremarkable sector of motley [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]], [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installations, and lightly-populated colonies.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], pursuing [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] from the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], fought a [[Duel on Yavin 4|duel]] with her on Yavin 4.<ref name="CW18">{{CW|18}}</ref> Later, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] was [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|captured]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]].<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref><ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref>

The Gordian Reach was represented by [[Quorl Matrin]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power.<ref name="SWG1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref> Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Reach was part of [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]]. After being forced to abandon the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Dantooine base]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made its headquarters on Yavin 4 in the Reach. The Rebels blazed numerous new hyperspace routes from the Yavin system should they need to escape to [[Ladarra]] and the [[Feswe Corridor]], and from there to the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] via [[Tertiary Feswe system/Legends|Tertiary Feswe]], to [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] via [[Feswe Minor system/Legends|Feswe Minor]], and to [[Hynah]] via [[Feswe Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the entire sector was [[Yavin blockade|blockaded]] by the Galactic Empire in an attempt to bottle up the Alliance's headquarters in the Yavin system.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the populations of many planets of the Reach were killed in the [[Stenax Massacres]], in which the [[Stenax]] destroyed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military outposts on many Reach worlds and also killed many non-Stenax civilians.<ref name="SWG1" />
